---
title: "body_data_dsc_generation"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

z <- read.table("bodydata.txt",header=TRUE)
nvars <- ncol(z)
write("bodydata.txt",file="dsc.txt")
write("NA",file="dsc.txt",append=TRUE)
write("2",file="dsc.txt",append=TRUE)
roles <- rep("n",nvars)
write.table(cbind(1:nvars,names(z),roles),file="dsc.txt",
col.names=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,append=TRUE,quote=FALSE)
```
